Fixed the JSON syntax error in `scenario.json`.

What changed: both `REPLACE` mutations (decoys C_D1 and C_D2) had a misplaced closing brace — `"query":{...}},"type":"REPLACE"}` — which closed `"mutation"` early and left `"type"` orphaned at the decoy level, breaking parsing around column 1265. Restructured each to `"query":{...},"type":"REPLACE"}` so `"type"` sits inside `"mutation"` per `docs/format.md`. No content (request, seed, decoys, query) was otherwise changed.

Scenario contents unchanged:
- Request: set the topic of the private channel with purpose 'Ship the spring release' that Omar Haddad is a member of.
- C_D1 — R:channel_members, F1 — posted in the channel but not a member.
- C_D2 — R:channel_members, F2 — reacted in the channel but not a member.
- C_D3 — R:channel_members, F8 — member is Omar Farouk (shares first name Omar).Done. `scenario.json` for `G4-SLK-13` (slack) is saved and structurally valid.

Request: Set the topic of the private channel with purpose 'Ship the spring release' that Omar Haddad is a member of to 'Dry run Thursday 10am in the main room'. Target `C_TGT` (`launch-bridge`); write is `conversations.setTopic`. Conditions: (c1) private, (c2) purpose text, (c3) Omar Haddad membership. Background channels each fail at least two conditions.

Decoys, all testing `R:channel_members` (fail c3 only, meet c1–c2):
- `C_D1` — fact `R:channel_members`, family F1 — offers posted-in-the-channel instead of membership (Omar authored a message there but is not a member).
- `C_D2` — fact `R:channel_members`, family F2 — offers reacted-in-the-channel instead of membership (Omar reacted `eyes` there but is not a member).
- `C_D3` — fact `R:channel_members`, family F8 — offers partial identity (member is Omar Farouk, shares the first name Omar, not Omar Haddad).

What changed in the fix: both `REPLACE` mutations had a misplaced brace (`"query":{...}},"type":"REPLACE"}`) that closed `mutation` early and broke parsing; restructured to `"query":{...},"type":"REPLACE"}` so `type` is inside `mutation`. No scenario content changed.

Validation note: shell execution is disabled in this session, so I could not run a JSON loader or the pipeline checker; I verified brace balance, required fields, unique query keys, and decoy/condition mapping by inspection against `docs/format.md`.
